question: Does parsed MAPNUMBER feed the numbered MapList selector, and what exact neutral state contract is closed when that producer edge is absent?

scope.boundary: This packet closes the neutral selector/update contract and a bounded absence of direct MAPNUMBER dataflow within the five-function read set. It does not prove the producer of either update argument, menu presentation, setup eligibility, map identity, resource acceptance, gameplay, save identity, multiplayer equality, or runtime loading.

dependencies.use: Provides the accepted MAPNUMBER-to-variator-slot-32 parser mapping and 64-slot scenario application copy.
Provides the accepted NumberedMapListSelect identity and MapList terminology.

arguments.r5: direct result override; zero requests MapList selection

stateUpdate.result: The update always stores r4 at +0x134. A zero r5 calls NumberedMapListSelect and stores its return at +0x138; a nonzero r5 bypasses the selector and is stored directly at +0x138.

selector.input: r4 retained from the update caller
selector.indexComposition: unsigned input modulo returned count, plus one
selector.return: the value returned by the selected MapList entry helper
selector.qualification: The bounded arithmetic does not establish player-facing numbering, a particular map identity, valid count behavior beyond the native trap guard, or runtime selection.

mapNumberNegative.acceptedProducer: Scenario parser name MAPNUMBER maps to signed variator slot 32; scenario application copies all 64 slots into the active variator block.
mapNumberNegative.boundedResult: None of 0x82DAECD0, 0x82DAEFD8, 0x82DAF5E0, 0x82DADC88, or 0x82E2B8D0 passes the parsed slot or active slot to update argument r4 or r5. The exact producer of those arguments therefore remains unresolved.
mapNumberNegative.qualification: This is a direct-edge negative inside the five-function read set, not an executable-wide absence. Callers outside the set may mediate the value through another object or field.

currentEvidence.method: Three sequential foreground read-only Ghidra queries plus narrow generated corroboration of the five selected functions.

entries.result: Four functions truncate at save-register thunks and NumberedMapListSelect truncates on bad instruction data in the configured project.
Raw words establish active-block base 0x830E8FD0 and the 128-byte halfword copy, placing slot 32 at 0x830E9010.
Raw words establish the override test, both +0x138 stores, the +0x134 store, and selector call.
Raw words establish unsigned division/remainder, plus-one argument, and selected-entry helper call.

currentEvidence.qualification: Generated bodies corroborate the exact current-image words hidden by configured-project truncation and bound the direct-edge negative. No runtime probe was performed.

guards: Keep MAPNUMBER variator ownership separate from the unresolved producer of update arguments r4 and r5.
Do not name +0x134 or +0x138 as MAPNUMBER fields without a producer edge.
Do not infer menu numbering, map identity, setup eligibility, resource acceptance, gameplay, persistence, multiplayer equality, or runtime behavior.
conclusion: MapListSelectionStateUpdate at 0x82DADC88 stores its retained input at +0x134 and either stores NumberedMapListSelect output or a direct nonzero override at +0x138. NumberedMapListSelect computes unsigned input modulo the current count plus one before selecting an entry. The bounded parser, scenario-apply, scanner, update, and selector set contains no direct MAPNUMBER-to-argument edge, so MAPNUMBER consumption remains unresolved.
